The logo

Darwaza: the doorway mark

The idea

Every family photograph is a doorway back home

  • The focus frame فوکسThe four corner marks every camera shows when it locks focus. It says "photography" without using another camera icon. The studio's promise: we focus on your moment.
  • The doorway دروازہThe arched door of a Punjabi home, the arch of a wedding stage and the shape of a framed portrait on the wall. It stands for family, welcome and the house where the photos hang.
  • Sunrise over the Potohar پوٹھوہارThe flat-topped ridges of the Potohar plateau around Chakwal, with the sun rising behind them. A new beginning: a wedding, a newborn, a first day at school. Gold is used only for the sun.

Aap ke ghar ki yaadein, Chakwal ki mitti se. A trusted local studio, drawn with the quality of a leading one.

Design process

Three concepts, one direction

Each concept was tested against the studio's real uses: a signboard read from a moving rickshaw on Pindi Road, a 40-pixel WhatsApp profile, and a gold stamp on a wedding album.

Concept A · Emotional

Naslein (Generations)

Three nested arches: grandparents, parents and the child at the centre, in gold. Like portraits from three generations hanging in one frame.

Strongest feeling of family. On its own it does not say "photography" or "Chakwal".

Concept B · Photography + place

Potohar Lens

A lens aperture whose opening shows the Potohar ridge and a rising sun. The landscape seen through the camera.

Clear photography read and real local reference. The aperture is common in the trade and goes muddy at small sizes.

Concept C · Typographic

CPS Heritage Seal

A round seal with a C·P·S monogram and the name set around the ring, like an old studio's embossing stamp.

Premium and classic, but small ring text fails on signboards and phones, and it feels distant.

Selected: Concept A as the foundation, since emotion is what brings a family through the door. It was refined with the Potohar sunrise from B, which is the only element that truly says Chakwal, and the camera focus frame for an instant photography read. C contributed the typography: a classical serif for CHAKWAL with an Urdu line for local customers.

Profile picture

Round logo for WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram

Every app crops the profile picture into a circle, so the logo now has a round version. Use the badge on Facebook and Instagram, and the simple icon on WhatsApp, where the picture is shown very small.

Service illustrations

A picture for every service

Drawn in the same line as the logo, so every post, highlight and album looks like one family. Used wherever a real photo is not yet available.

In use

How it looks in Chakwal

Advertising

The ad, in three sizes

Replaces the old poster. Same services, plus the new All Size Photo Prints, Frames & Crystals, in English and Urdu, with both contact numbers large enough to read on a phone.

The arch window shows the brand's Potohar illustration for now. Put the studio's own best wedding photo in it: customers trust real work far more than stock or AI pictures. The generator does this in one step with --photo.

Social media kit

Six service posts, ready to publish

One post per service, each ending with the same call to action: آج ہی تشریف لائیں (visit us today), with both numbers and the address. Post one a day, then repeat.

Add the studio's own photos

Each arch window takes a real photo. Save the best pictures as wedding.jpg, baby.jpg, family.jpg, passport.jpg, prints.jpg and drone.jpg in source/photos/ and run the generator again: every post updates in one step. Real work from Chakwal families builds far more trust than stock or AI pictures. Take written consent before posting a client's photo, especially of women and children.

Story highlight covers

Print kit

Album covers, signboard and order slip

12 × 12 in print PDFs. Names and dates are samples; change them per client in the generator (ALBUMS in kit.py).

Order slip / receipt

A5, English and Urdu labels: customer, phone, event, date, venue, items with size, quantity and rate, total, advance, balance and delivery date. Print as a numbered book in duplicate so every order has a record.

Usage

Rules and files

Clear space

Keep empty space around the logo equal to the height of the "C" in CHAKWAL. No text, borders or photos inside it.

Minimum size

Horizontal logo: 30 mm wide in print, 160 px on screen. Below that, use the mark alone (8 mm / 24 px).

Do not change

Do not recolour the sun, stretch the logo, add shadows or glow, or retype the name in another font. Use the supplied files only.
